Scale_Range: 1=Limited | 2=Developing | 3=Proficient | 4=Exceptional

Scale_Range: 1=Limited | 2=Developing | 3=Proficient | 4=Exceptional

Scale_Range: 1=Limited | 2=Developing | 3=Proficient | 4=Exceptional

Scale_Range: 1=Limited | 2=Developing | 3=Proficient | 4=Exceptional

Scale_Range: 1=Limited | 2=Developing | 3=Proficient | 4=Exceptional

Scale_Range: 1=Limited | 2=Developing | 3=Proficient | 4=Exceptional

Scale_Range: 1=Limited | 2=Developing | 3=Proficient | 4=Exceptional

Scale_Range: 1=Limited | 2=Developing | 3=Proficient | 4=Exceptional

Assessment_Method: 360-degree Feedback + Direct Report Survey + Assessment Centre
